title: Preparing for volunteer work
passage:
Woman: Our company volunteers are scheduled to pack food parcels at the community center on Friday.
Man: I saw the email. Are we meeting there directly?
Woman: A shuttle will leave the office at one. If you drive yourself, please arrive at the center by one thirty.
Man: Should we bring boxes or packing tape?
Woman: The center supplies both. They only ask us to wear closed-toe shoes.
Man: All right. I'll take the shuttle and remind my department about the footwear requirement.
passageZh:
女：我們公司的志工星期五預定到社區中心打包食物包裹。
男：我看到郵件了。我們直接在那裡集合嗎？
女：接駁車一點從辦公室出發。如果你自行開車，請最遲在一點半抵達社區中心。
男：我們需要帶箱子或包裝膠帶嗎？
女：中心會提供這兩樣。他們只要求我們穿包覆腳趾的鞋子。
男：好。我會搭接駁車，也會提醒部門同事注意鞋子的要求。
